name: Ping Identity
description: Connect your own PingOne environment (Worker Application) to manage Users, Groups, Populations, Applications, Sign-On Policies and Identity Providers, plus review the Activity log for security visibility.

tools.name: connect_ping
tools.description: Connect a PingOne environment via a Worker Application (client credentials), after verifying connectivity.

region.description: PingOne region: NA, EU, AP, or CA.
region.title: Region

environment_id.description: PingOne environment ID (UUID), from Environment > Overview.
environment_id.title: Environment Id

tools.name: disconnect_ping
tools.description: Disconnect a PingOne environment: deletes only the saved credentials. Nothing in PingOne itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved PingOne environment connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected PingOne environments.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the connected PingOne environment, optionally filtered by a search string.

connection_id.description: Optional saved PingOne environment connection ID. Omit to use the first connected environment.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

q.description: Optional search filter matching username/email prefix.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Read one PingOne user in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved PingOne environment connection ID. Omit to use the first connected environment.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Create a new PingOne user in a population.

connection_id.description: Optional saved PingOne environment connection ID. Omit to use the first connected environment.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

population_id.description: Population ID this user belongs to.
population_id.title: Population Id

password.description: Optional initial password (if population's password policy allows admin-set passwords).
password.title: Password

tools.name: update_user
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing PingOne user. Only given fields change.

connection_id.description: Optional saved PingOne environment connection ID. Omit to use the first connected environment.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

email.description: New email address, or leave blank to keep unchanged.
email.title: Email

given_name.description: New first name, or leave blank to keep unchanged.
given_name.title: Given Name

family_name.description: New last name, or leave blank to keep unchanged.
family_name.title: Family Name

tools.name: enable_user
tools.description: Enable a disabled PingOne user, restoring their sign-in access.

connection_id.description: Optional saved PingOne environment connection ID. Omit to use the first connected environment.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

connection_id.description: Optional saved PingOne environment connection ID. Omit to use the first connected environment.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: delete_user
tools.description: Permanently delete a PingOne user. Cannot be undone -- unlike Okta's deactivate, PingOne performs a real, irreversible delete.

connection_id.description: Optional saved PingOne environment connection ID. Omit to use the first connected environment.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.description: Trigger PingOne's own password-reset flow for a user (sends them a reset email/notification).
